title: Issue #9474  OnBeforeDecreaseQtyForMaxQty
summary: Added an event hook to allow extensions to intervene before the system decreases quantity for maximum quantity calculations in inventory offsetting.
key_points: New OnBeforeDecreaseQtyForMaxQty event added to Inventory Profile Offsetting codeunit
Enables extensions to intercept and potentially modify the quantity decrease logic
Supports customization without modifying base application code
Follows standard Business Central event pattern for extensibility
No breaking changes to existing functionality
